The vendor directly providing **Akuma** at **akuma.ai** is **Kinkaku, Inc.** (**Kinkaku株式会社**).

### Provider Statement & Evidence
* **Product and Domain:** The evidence specifically concerns **Akuma** / **akuma.ai** (an anime-style image generation platform featuring a real-time AI canvas).
* **Company Statements:**
  * In official release announcements for the platform, the operating entity states:  
    > *"Kinkaku株式会社（本社：東京都渋谷区、代表取締役：福山裕介）はこのたび、画像生成クラウドAIサービス「Akuma.ai」正式版の提供を開始いたしました。"* (Kinkaku, Inc. launched and operates the image generation cloud AI service `Akuma.ai`).
  * When releasing the real-time AI canvas feature for `akuma.ai`, Kinkaku announced:  
    > *"生成AIスタートアップKinkaku、リアルタイム画像生成ツール「AIキャンバス」をリリース"* (Generative AI startup Kinkaku releases real-time image generation tool "AI Canvas" at `akuma.ai`).
  * Kinkaku's corporate site confirms:  
    > *"現在、AIロールプレイアプリ「Anirole」（旧Akuma.ai）を開発・運営しています。"* (Currently developing and operating Anirole, formerly Akuma.ai).
